purpose: Synthetic structural dry-run contract for verifying that a cooperating facility can package the v3.27 R2 evidence roles without weakening provenance or claim boundaries.

dryrun_status_semantics.STRUCTURAL_PASS: All v3.27 packet roles are represented exactly once, paths are safe, bytes and SHA-256 match, and every dry-run object is explicitly synthetic or real. This is not a scientific PASS.
dryrun_status_semantics.FAIL: The packet is present but violates integrity, uniqueness, path-safety, or claim-boundary rules.
dryrun_status_semantics.INCOMPLETE: One or more v3.27 required packet roles or required provenance fields are missing. Missing evidence may not be represented as zero uncertainty or scientific PASS.
